title: 🤖 Provider API update - anthropic@2.1.0
body:
### New features

- POST /v1/complete
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (hybrid model with near-instant responses and extended thinking)

- POST /v1/messages
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- POST /v1/messages?beta=true
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- POST /v1/messages/batches
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- POST /v1/messages/batches?beta=true
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- GET /v1/messages/batches/{message_batch_id}/results
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- GET /v1/messages/batches/{message_batch_id}/results?beta=true
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- POST /v1/messages/count_tokens
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

- POST /v1/messages/count_tokens?beta=true
  - Added supported model values: claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
